description: This file defines a PHP class for handling exceptions related to security restrictions in Twig's sandbox environment, specifically for cases where a not allowed filter is used in a template.

classes.name: SecurityNotAllowedFilterError
classes.description: An exception class thrown when an unpermitted filter is used in a Twig template, extending SecurityError and capturing the filter name involved.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the error with a message and the name of the filter that is not allowed.

methods.name: getFilterName
methods.description: Returns the name of the filter that triggered this error.
